role: Paper I baseline marginal financing terms
definition: Annual LIBOR plus contractual Brazil spread over LIBOR; Brazil spread for 1974 covers last three quarters
measurement_warning: Marginal loan pricing; includes global LIBOR benchmark and Brazil-specific contractual spread

role: Paper I robustness marginal loan spread
definition: Direct Brazil new-loan spread over LIBOR reproduced by Sachs from Fishlow
measurement_warning: Robustness source; 1980 differs materially from some revised sources

definition: Brazil commercial-money spread around 1.5 percentage points over LIBOR; not a full-year average
measurement_warning: Approximate mid-year observation only; never label as annual average

definition: Effective average external-debt cost spread sourced to Cardoso & Fishlow; not the same as marginal loan spread
measurement_warning: Inherited-debt average cost measure; legacy fixed/floating composition creates repricing lag

role: Paper II early debt-crisis market-risk evidence
definition: Brazil sovereign-bond yield spread relative to comparable high-grade benchmark; market measure during debt crisis
measurement_warning: Do not splice mechanically to bank-loan spread; instrument and market regime differ

coverage: annual 1985-1989 used here; richer 1986-90 market data exist
definition: Price of Brazilian external bank debt in cents per dollar of face value
measurement_warning: A debt price is not an interest spread unless coupon, maturity, recovery and payment timing are modeled

coverage: Brazil EMBI coverage begins 1991-12-31 in cited research dataset
definition: Market sovereign spread series; use actual underlying EMBI data when Paper II/III database is built
measurement_warning: EMBI composition changes over time; document index definition when Paper III is built

coverage: Brady restructuring completed / bonds issued April 1994
definition: Tradable restructured sovereign claims; useful for Real Plan-era market risk
measurement_warning: Brady and Eurobond instruments can have different collateral/maturity; prefer standardized spread measures when available

definition: Debt-elastic premium p(d)=psi2*(exp(d-dbar)-1); psi2 baseline 0.000742 in original calibration
measurement_warning: Original calibration is not Brazil-specific and uses a different model frequency/normalization

definition: Quarterly SOE literature uses risk-premium elasticity 0.001 as small stationarity parameter comparable to SGU
measurement_warning: Chosen as parsimonious quarterly stationarity calibration, not as an estimated Brazilian causal elasticity
